scenario: Authenticated Web TS-CORE-01 moves from explicit reviewed synthetic submit through retained exact evidence, recruiter decisions and correction, separately version-bound approval, unknown-result reconciliation, verified readback, cancellation, repeated offline retry, and idempotent same-key recovery.

review_plan.reason: The artifact includes 390px long-content, keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, contrast, cancellation, and recovery evidence.
The artifact changes the recruiter evidence-review, dismissal, action-authority, and recovery workflow.
The artifact retains candidate conversation evidence and controls recruiter interpretation, action, and retention.
The artifact handles identity, provenance, retention, idempotency, authority, readback, and an active browser-capture veto.
No candidate assessment, ranking, comparison, scorecard, or validity claim changed.
No performance-based hiring or win-win outcome claim changed.
No executive-potential model or longitudinal assessment is present.
The artifact does not infer motivation or recommend a candidate decision.
No sourcing strategy, talent map, query, or discovery ranking changed.
This is a bounded implementation and evidence review, not a current market scan.

reviews.lens: responsive task completion, focus, assistive semantics, motion preference, and constrained-layout state truth

findings.criterion: Native zoom and manual screen-reader proof
findings.observation: The 390px mixed-script path, keyboard order, exact-source focus, reduced motion, and stable light/dark axe scans are direct. Native 200% Chrome zoom and a real screen reader remain unproven.
findings.user_impact: Narrow-browser users have direct coverage while zoom and spoken traversal could still contain an unobserved defect.
findings.recommendation: Run native 200% zoom and one manual VoiceOver or NVDA traversal.
findings.verification: All evidence, decisions, authority, and recovery remain unclipped, ordered, focusable, and correctly announced.

strengths: The measured 1675px overflow was reduced to exactly 390px.
Cancellation, repeated retry, restart recovery, and reduced motion are direct.

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, bounded decisions, useful next action, and honest recovery

findings.observation: The production flow directly covers source, correction, dismissal, separate approval, unknown result, reconciliation, cancellation, and retry, but no first-time recruiter was observed.
findings.user_impact: Experienced operators can recover safely while first-use authority comprehension remains inferred.
findings.recommendation: Run an uncoached recruiter walkthrough and require a plain-language explanation of each authority transition.
findings.verification: The participant completes TS-CORE-01 without prompting or false effect and outcome claims.

strengths: A dismissed required fact now blocks authority with an honest explanation.
Unknown result blocks repeat execution until reconciliation.

reviews.lens: human-first evidence handling, respectful uncertainty, recruiter restraint, and avoidance of manufactured urgency

findings.criterion: Live candidate transparency and consent language
findings.observation: The synthetic record retains reviewed selected text under a named policy and deadline, preserves candidate words beside recruiter correction, and performs no candidate contact. Live notice and correction language were not evaluated.
findings.user_impact: The localhost slice is restrained, while a live candidate would still need understandable notice and recourse.
findings.recommendation: Before live data, evaluate notice, purpose limitation, correction, retention, and deletion.
findings.verification: A candidate can learn what was retained, why, until when, and how it can be corrected or deleted.

strengths: The original quote survives recruiter correction.
Dismissal grants no authority and no state ranks candidate worth.

reviews.lens: intentional capture, provenance, retention, account scope, idempotency, authority, and truthful outcome

findings.observation: The Web path is account-scoped, synthetic, source-linked, retained with an explicit deadline, idempotent, and localhost-only after receipt. The connected normal Chrome control timed out, so selected-text invocation, temporary activeTab scope, and pre-Submit silence remain unproven.
findings.user_impact: The downstream Web workflow can be safe while the integrated journey lacks proof that evidence entered through the promised browser gesture.
findings.recommendation: Run the frozen extension in a policy-authorized visible Chrome profile.
findings.verification: A direct trace proves temporary selected-text scope, exact preview, pre-Submit silence, explicit Submit, and one account-scoped receipt.

strengths: Evidence crop returns a truthful source-access receipt and deadline.
Same-key replay leaves capture, approval, effect, and audit state unchanged.
Capability revocation blocks execution without rewriting or hiding an existing active approval.
No off-localhost request or external write was observed.
vetoes: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.

top_findings.reason: The Web slice is direct after receipt, but visible selected-text invocation, temporary browser scope, and pre-Submit silence remain unproven.
top_findings.next_step: Run the frozen extension in a policy-authorized visible Chrome profile.
top_findings.verification: One trace proves scoped synthetic capture, no pre-Submit transfer, and one account-scoped receipt.

top_findings.criterion: Native zoom and manual assistive technology
top_findings.reason: The 390px mixed-content path and automated accessibility evidence are direct, but native 200% zoom and spoken traversal remain unproven.
top_findings.next_step: Run native 200% Chrome zoom and one VoiceOver or NVDA traversal.
top_findings.verification: All evidence and authority states remain readable, reachable, ordered, and truthfully announced.

top_findings.reason: No uncoached first-time recruiter demonstrated the authority model.
top_findings.verification: The participant completes TS-CORE-01 without prompting or false outcome claims.

agreements: The Web slice is quiet, product-specific, evidence-first, and directly usable with long content at 390px.
Source, proposed interpretation, confirmed state, approval, effect attempt, and observed readback remain distinct.
Dismissed requirement, stale approval, unknown result, cancellation, offline retry, and restart recovery avoid false authority or false success.
Capability revocation remains distinct from approval: it suppresses approval and execution paths while preserving independent revocation of an existing active approval.
Evidence crop and same-key replay preserve exact source, account scope, retention truth, and idempotency.
No candidate contact or external write occurred.

disagreements.issue: Whether the completed backend-owned Web proof is sufficient for integrated release.

positions.position: The Web workflow passes with changes because the decision and recovery path is direct.
The integrated journey fails while visible user-Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence remain unproven.

disagreements.resolution: Preserve the Web dimension results independently and keep the integrated journey at zero.
disagreements.resolution_basis: An active evidence-safety veto is not averaged against downstream Web craft evidence.

veto_resolution.veto: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.

adjudication.rationale: Round 4 directly closes six Web defects and adds retained-source, exact same-key replay, long mixed-content, source focus, capability-versus-approval separation, cancellation, repeated retry, restart recovery, stable theme, and reduced-motion proof. Only evidence proximity and interaction motion move to 98. Narrative, typography, responsive composition, and keyboard accessibility remain unchanged because uncoached comprehension, native 200% Chrome zoom, and manual screen-reader traversal were not completed. XS-CAPTURE-01 remains active and blocks the independent integrated journey.
